faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything principals ask us during demos.

items.q: How much does Klasso cost for my school?
items.a: Pricing is per student (7/6/5 TND excl. tax / month by tier, or 59/49/39 TND / year on annual billing). Billed monthly or annually, 30-day free trial with no card.

items.q: How do I migrate from my current Excel files?
items.a: Klasso includes bulk CSV import (V2 — already delivered). You download a template, fill it in, and upload it: all your students are created in seconds.
A dedicated parent app is coming in summer 2026 (roadmap V3). In the meantime, you can export per-student PDF records.

items.q: Does my data stay in Tunisia?
items.a: Primary hosting in the EU (Neon Postgres + Vercel) + edge CDN with a local TN point of presence. Encrypted daily backups.

items.q: How does Klasso protect minors' data?
items.a: Strict GDPR, multi-tenant isolation verified by automated tests, audit logs, and right to be forgotten implemented on the API side.
The displayed prices assume an annual commitment (quarterly payment available on the Pro plan). 30-day free trial before any billing.
Yes — full FR + AR interface with native RTL support. You switch languages at any time via the footer selector.

items.q: How do you train my teaching team?
items.a: Personalised onboarding included in the Pro plan (video call + documentation). Starter/Standard plans: email support + tutorial videos.
